title: Crystal Chaos
description: A mod that adds a bunch more Crystal related Weapons
body:
### **What does this mod do?**
This mod adds a new type of material called the Twisted Shard, with this you can craft other useful materials that will help you to create powerful weapons. With that there are also useful tools crafted with base game materials like the Amethyst Longsword.

### Features
- Twisted Shards
- Twisted Sticks
- The Twisted Bane and its 2 different skins made with a Magma Cream and a Twisted shard in and Upgrade table using the new Twisted Upgrade template
- An Amethyst Longsword
- The Crystalline Chaos
- A new Painting called "Artist" made by NotSoTwisted
- And more to come in the Future!
